focus: Auto-tick-and-lock of pawns in Dialog_EnterDungeon (interactive=false, static Locked set, undo/redo in SelectionChanged) and the DoCountAdjustInterface tooltip postfix
diffSource: since build 14 (2026-10-07T16:50:04Z), the last reviewed build, from the build log

findings.title: DoInfo and TryAccept still pick `going` from caravan.PawnsListForReading while SelectionChanged now uses party
findings.detail: After this change party already holds every pawn when everyone is true, so `everyone ? caravan.PawnsListForReading : party` at lines 197 and 253 is a second definition of who goes in. They agree today, but the shown wealth/head count and what Enter receives can drift apart on a later edit. Replace both with `party` so the dialog has one source.

findings.title: Rescue caravan only picks p.IsColonist, so a lone carried-out slave still vanishes with the site
findings.detail: IsColonist is false for slaves, so the new branch skips them and the stash is never flushed to a caravan. Use CaravanUtility.IsOwner(p, Faction.OfPlayer) && p.RaceProps.Humanlike (the test DungeonEntry already uses) if slaves should be saved too.

findings.title: Setting everyoneLeft = true for the rescued colonist suppresses the PartyLost letter even if colonist corpses remain inside
findings.detail: With the new caravan non-null and everyoneLeft true, `!everyoneLeft || (anyCorpse && caravan == null)` is false. This matches the existing behaviour when a waiting caravan exists, so it is probably intended, but a party that lost most of its members now gets no letter.

findings.title: Locked-row tooltip covers only the count/checkbox rect, not the row
findings.detail: DoRow passes only the count-area rect to DoCountAdjustInterface, so hovering the pawn's name shows nothing. Fine if intended; the corpus is silent on this target.

findings.title: Unticking a self-ticked non-leader in everyone mode re-ticks and locks it immediately
findings.detail: The undo/redo in SelectionChanged makes the click look ignored; the rules require it, but the player gets no feedback on that click. Opinion.
